description: Event catalogue for the SM&CR Dashboard and Accountability Review journey. Introduces 1 event: EVT-165. Published by SVC-015 (Compliance Core, CAP-005).

events.name: SmscrReviewCompleted
events.trigger: Head of Compliance (SMF16) signs off quarterly SM&CR review with no outstanding conduct breaches requiring immediate notification. SmscrReview status set to closed.

consumers.action: Write immutable quarterly SM&CR review completion record (FCA enforcement evidence).

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-quarter ordering via review_quarter partition key on topic compliance.smcr.
events.worm_rationale: SM&CR review completion with SMF attestation is FCA enforcement evidence — must be immutable.
